title: Openness of versality from a perfect dual obstruction theory
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: When K^bullet is perfect, replace it by a finite complex of finite projectives and let E = (K^bullet)^vee[-1] be the dual perfect complex; the class xi from lemma-dual-obstruction gives E -> NL_{A/Lambda}, and the identifications H^2(K (L) -) = Ext^1(E, -) and H^1(K (L) -) = Ext^0(E, -) transfer conclusions (1) and (2) of lemma-dual-obstruction into assumptions (i) and (ii) of lemma-openness, with (iii) clear from perfection, so openness of versality follows.
